name: genome-room-prototype

scripts.// prebuild: viz_sandbox is a fast-moving prototype we always track at main; npm ci installs the lockfile-pinned commit, so refresh to main HEAD before every build (CI + local) to keep the pin inert.

comment:optionalDependencies: Pin the Linux rollup native binary (matching the locked rollup version) so CI on ubuntu installs it. A macOS-generated lockfile otherwise omits it and the build fails with 'Cannot find module @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu' (npm/cli#4828). It's optional, so macOS/other platforms skip it cleanly.
comment:overrides: viz_sandbox is built against the deck.gl/luma 9.1.x line; caret ranges otherwise float a fresh install to 9.3.x, which breaks rendering with 'Invalid coordinateSystem: 0'. loaders.gl is pinned to 4.3.3 for the same reason (its 4.4.x packages drift apart and peer-conflict). Pin all three stacks so a downstream install can't drift.
